comment: Ordered rules, FIRST MATCH WINS. match = exact path, directory prefix (trailing slash optional) or glob (* ? [ ] ; * also crosses /). only_if=referenced keeps a file only when index.html, js/*.js or css/*.css names it (scripts/release/check_asset_refs.py); otherwise the rule is skipped and the next rule decides. The last rule is the catch-all EXCLUDE. Source: docs/kiro_84_release_plan_claude-sonnet-5.5.md section 1.
